Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: गुस्सा या परेशानी के बाद शरीर के बाहरी हिस्से पर सुई चुभने जैसा दर्द होता है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Gussa ya pareshani ke baad sharir ke bahari hisse par sui chubne jaisa dard hota hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return once a year, around the same time each year.
General.hi: तकलीफें हर साल एक ही समय पर लौटती हैं।
General.roman: Takleef har saal ek hi samay par lautti hain.

General.path: Generalities, periodicity, complaints return at same hour
General.en: Your symptoms return at the same time of day each time they come back.
General.hi: बीमारी हर बार एक ही घंटे पर वापस आती है।
General.roman: Bimari har bar ek hi ghante par wapas ati hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return every fourteen days.
General.hi: तकलीफ हर चौदहवें दिन फिर से होती है।
General.roman: Taklif har chaudahve din phir se hoti hai.

General.path: Generalities, periodicity, neuralgia every day at same hour
General.en: You have nerve pain that comes back every day at the same time.
General.hi: नसों का दर्द हर दिन एक ही समय पर होता है।
General.roman: Nason ka dard har din ek hi samay par hota hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return every seven days.
General.hi: तकलीफ हर सातवें दिन फिर से होती है।
General.roman: Taklif har satwe din phir se hoti hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return every twenty-eight days.
General.hi: तकलीफ हर अट्ठाईसवें दिन फिर से होती है।
General.roman: Taklif har atthaaise din phir se hoti hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return every twenty-one days.
General.hi: तकलीफ हर इक्कीसवें दिन फिर से होती है।
General.roman: Taklif har ikkise din phir se hoti hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return once every week.
General.hi: तकलीफ हर हफ्ते फिर से होती है।
General.roman: Taklif har hafte phir se hoti hai.

General.en: Your symptoms return once every year.
General.hi: तकलीफ हर साल फिर से होती है।
General.roman: taklif har saal phir se hoti hai.

General.en: You notice symptoms or changes after you have been sweating.
General.hi: पसीना आने के बाद तकलीफ होती है।
General.roman: pasina aane ke baad taklif hoti hai.

General.en: Your symptoms get worse after sweating.
General.hi: पसीना आने के बाद तकलीफ और बढ़ जाती है।
General.roman: pasina aane ke baad taklif aur badh jati hai.

General.en: Your symptoms get better after sweating.
General.hi: पसीना आने के बाद तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
General.roman: pasina aane ke baad taklif kam ho jati hai.

General.en: Sweating makes your symptoms better or brings relief.
General.hi: पसीना आने से तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
General.roman: pasina aane se taklif kam ho jati hai.

General.en: A cold sweat makes your symptoms better or brings relief.
General.hi: ठंडा पसीना आने से तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
General.roman: thanda pasina aane se taklif kam ho jati hai.

General.en: Sweating gives you no relief at all from your symptoms.
General.hi: पसीना आने पर भी कोई आराम नहीं मिलता।
General.roman: pasina aane par bhi koi aaram nahi milta.

General.en: Your sweat feels sticky or clammy on the skin.
General.hi: शरीर से चिपचिपा पसीना आता है।
General.roman: sharir se chipchipa pasina aata hai.

General.en: Your sweating was stopped or blocked, and this seems to have caused or worsened your symptoms.
General.hi: पसीना बंद हो जाने से तकलीफ होती है।
General.roman: pasina band ho jane se taklif hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a sensation as if a plug or stopper is stuck somewhere in the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर में किसी जगह कुछ ठूँसा हुआ या प्लग लगा होने जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: sharir mein kisi jagah kuch thussa hua ya plug laga hone jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a sensation on the surface of the body as if a plug or stopper is stuck there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: बाहर से शरीर पर कुछ अटका हुआ या दबा हुआ-सा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: bahar se sharir par kuch atka hua ya daba hua-sa lagta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a sensation deep inside the body as if a plug or stopper is stuck there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: अंदर से शरीर में कुछ ठूँसा हुआ या अटका हुआ-सा लगता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: andar se sharir mein kuch thussa hua ya atka hua-sa lagta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Pressure on the body makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: दबाव पड़ने से तकलीफ और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: dabav padne se taklif aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Pressure on the body makes your symptoms better.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: दबाव देने से तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: dabav dene se taklif kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Generalities, pressure, on painless side agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: Pressing on the side of the body that does not hurt makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जहाँ दर्द नहीं है उस तरफ दबाव पड़ने से दर्द वाली जगह तकलीफ और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: jahan dard nahi hai us taraf dabav padne se dard vali jagah taklif aur badh jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a prickling sensation on the surface or skin of the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर के बाहरी हिस्से पर चुभन जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Shareer ke bahari hisse par chuban jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a prickling sensation deep inside the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर के अंदर चुभन जैसा एहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Shareer ke andar chuban jaisa ehsas hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface or outside of the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर के बाहरी हिस्से में धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Shareer ke bahari hisse mein dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: The throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body has a trembling or quivering quality.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर के बाहर काँपती हुई या थरथराती हुई धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sharir ke bahar kanpti hui ya tharthrati hui dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation deep inside the body.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: शरीर के अंदर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sharir ke andar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body in the afternoon, between 2:00 and 2:30 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर को दो बजकर तीस मिनट पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ko do bajkar tis minut par shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ke samay shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body during the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, evening, rest, during
Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body during the evening while resting.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को आराम करते समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko aaram karte samay shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, morning, on waking
Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body in the morning upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठते समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthte samay shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke samay sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, night, coughing, from
Linked to time of day.en: Coughing at night brings on or worsens the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को खाँसने से शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko khanste se sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, night, half awake, while
Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body at night while half awake.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी नींद में शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi nind mein sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke samay sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, night, midnight, after 4 a.m.
Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body at night, after 4:00 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को आधी रात के बाद सुबह चार बजे शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko aadhi raat ke baad subah char baje sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद से जागने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind se jagne par sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, air, open, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in fresh open air makes the throbbing or pulsating sensation on your body's surface better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से शरीर की बाहरी धड़कन कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane se shareer ki bahari dhadkan kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body when you are in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर लेटने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Bistar par letne par shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rehne par shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithe rehne par sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body while standing.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खड़े रहने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Khade rehne par sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Coughing brings on or worsens the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसते समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khante samay shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Physical effort or exertion brings on or worsens the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: मेहनत या कसरत करने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Mehnat ya kasrat karne par shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Moving around makes the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body worse.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-चलने से शरीर की बाहरी धड़कन और बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-chalne se shareer ki bahari dhadkan aur badh jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Moving around makes the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body better.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: हिलने-चलने से शरीर की बाहरी धड़कन कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Hilne-chalne se shareer ki bahari dhadkan kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, touches anything when body
Triggered by specific actions.en: The throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body comes on whenever your body touches or brushes against something.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जब शरीर किसी चीज़ को छूता है तो शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jab sharir kisi chiz ko chuta hai to sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body while walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalne par sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, walking, in open air, after
Triggered by specific actions.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body after walking in the open air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खुली हवा में चलने के बाद शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khuli hawa mein chalne ke baad sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body starts or gets worse after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Excitement or emotional agitation makes the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body worse.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: उत्साह या興奋होने पर शरीर के बाहर धड़कन और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Utsah ya excitement hone par shareer ke bahar dhadkan aur badh jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Listening to music makes the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body worse.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: संगीत सुनने से शरीर के बाहर धड़कन और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Sangeet sunne se sharir ke bahar dhadkan aur badh jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Listening to sad or plaintive music brings on or worsens the throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: दुखद या करुण संगीत सुनने से शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Dukhad ya karun sangeet sunne se sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body along with a headache.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सिरदर्द के साथ शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sirdar ke saath shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body just before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी से पहले शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari se pehle shareer ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

General.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body during pregnancy.
General.hi: गर्भावस्था के दौरान शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
General.roman: Garbhavastha ke dauran sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

General.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body during sleep.
General.hi: नींद के दौरान शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
General.roman: Nind ke dauran sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Generalities, pulsation, externally, speaking in company, while
Triggered by specific situations.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation on the surface of the body while speaking to others in company.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: लोगों के बीच बात करते समय शरीर के बाहर धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Logo ke beech baat karte samay sharir ke bahar dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation deep inside the blood vessels.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: अंदर की नसों में धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Andar ki nason mein dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation in the glands of the body.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: शरीर की ग्रंथियों (गाँठों) में धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sharir ki granthiyon (ganth) mein dhadkan mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: You have a throbbing or pulsating sensation in the veins.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: शरीर की नसों में धड़कन महसूस होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sharir ki nason mein dhadkan mehsoos hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Generalities, quivering, all over followed by vertigo
Comes with other symptoms.en: You have a quivering sensation all over the body that is followed by dizziness.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: पूरे शरीर में कँपकँपी होती है और उसके बाद चक्कर आते हैं।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Pure sharir mein kampkampi hoti hai aur uske baad chakkar aate hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: You have a quivering or trembling sensation in the glands of the body.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: शरीर की ग्रंथियों (गाँठों) में कँपकँपी होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Sharir ki granthiyon (gaaton) mein kampkampi hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You have a quivering or trembling sensation in the body while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर शरीर में कँपकँपी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rehne par sharir mein kampkampi hoti hai.

General sensation.en: The connective tissues in your body feel loose or slack, as if lacking their normal firmness.
General sensation.hi: शरीर के जोड़ों और ऊतकों में ढीलापन महसूस होता है।
General sensation.roman: Sharir ke jodon aur uttkon mein dhilpan mehsoos hota hai.

General sensation.en: You have a general physical feeling of looseness, laxity, or lack of tone in the body.

General sensation.en: Your cartilages (the firm, rubbery tissue at joints and other areas) feel unusually tender or sensitive.

General sensation.roman: sharir ki haddiyon ke jodron ki upassthhi bahut sanvedansheel aur chhune mein dardnak lagti hai.

General sensation.en: The surface of your body feels unusually sensitive to touch.
General sensation.hi: शरीर की बाहरी त्वचा या हिस्से बहुत संवेदनशील हो गए हैं, हल्का सा स्पर्श भी असहनीय लगता है।
General sensation.roman: sharir ki bahari twcha ya hisse bahut sanvedansheel ho gaye hain, halka sa sparsh bhi asahni lagta hai.

General sensation.en: Your glands feel unusually tender or sensitive.
General sensation.hi: शरीर की ग्रंथियाँ (गिल्टियाँ) बहुत संवेदनशील और दर्दनाक हो गई हैं।
General sensation.roman: sharir ki granthiya bahut sanvedansheel aur dardnak ho gai hain.

General sensation.en: The inside of your body feels unusually sensitive.
General sensation.hi: शरीर के अंदर से बहुत संवेदनशीलता महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: sharir ke andar se bahut sanvedanshilta mehsus hoti hai.

General sensation.en: The surface of your bones feels unusually tender or sensitive.
General sensation.hi: हड्डियों की ऊपरी परत (पेरीओस्टियम) बहुत संवेदनशील और दर्दनाक है।
General sensation.roman: haddiyon ki upri parat bahut sanvedansheel aur dardnak hai.

General sensation.en: You have an unusually low tolerance for pain — even minor pain feels very intense.
General sensation.hi: दर्द सहने की ताकत बहुत कम हो गई है, थोड़ा सा दर्द भी बहुत ज़्यादा लगता है।
General sensation.roman: dard sahne ki taakat bahut kam ho gai hai, thoda sa dard bhi bahut zyada lagta hai.

General.roman: yaun ichchha bahut zyada badh gai hai.

General sensation.en: You experience sudden electric shock-like sensations in your body.
General sensation.hi: शरीर में बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Sharir mein bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, concussion of brain, from
General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations that seem to come from a concussion (head injury).
General sensation.hi: सिर पर चोट लगने (दिमागी आघात) के कारण बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Sir par chot lagne (dimagi aaghat) ke karan bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations along with convulsions (fits).
General sensation.hi: दौरे (मिर्गी जैसी ऐंठन) के साथ बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Daure (mirgi jaisi ainthan) ke sath bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations just before a convulsion (fit) starts.
General sensation.hi: दौरे से पहले बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Daure se pehle bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, convulsions, interrupted by painful shocks
General sensation.en: During a convulsion (fit), the episode is broken up by painful electric shock-like jolts.
General sensation.hi: दौरे के बीच में दर्दनाक झटकों से दौरा रुक जाता है।
General sensation.roman: Daure ke beech mein dardnak jhatkon se daura ruk jata hai.

General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations just before an epileptic episode.
General sensation.hi: मिर्गी का दौरा पड़ने से पहले बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Mirgi ka daura padne se pehle bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations while lying down.
General sensation.hi: लेटे रहने के दौरान बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Lete rehne ke dauran bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, motion or rest, during
General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations whether you are moving or still.
General sensation.hi: हिलने-डुलने या आराम करने के दौरान बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Hilne-dulne ya aaram karne ke dauran bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, move, on beginning to
General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations right when you start to move.
General sensation.hi: हिलना-डुलना शुरू करते ही बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Hilna-dulna shuru karte hi bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations when you start to regain consciousness or awareness.

General sensation.roman: Behoshi se hosh mein aate samay bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, right side of body

General sensation.hi: शरीर के दाईं तरफ बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Sharir ke dain taraf bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.en: Electric shock-like sensations are connected to sleep.
General sensation.hi: नींद से जुड़े बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।

General sensation.hi: नींद के दौरान बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Nind ke dauran bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, sleep, on going to
General sensation.en: You experience electric shock-like sensations just as you are falling asleep.
General sensation.hi: सोते समय (नींद आते-आते) बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Sote samay (nind aate-aate) bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.path: Generalities, shocks, electric-like, slow pulse, with

General sensation.hi: नाड़ी (पल्स) धीमी होने के साथ-साथ बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Nadi (pulse) dheemi hone ke sath-sath bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.hi: किसी चीज़ को छूने पर बिजली जैसा झटका लगता है।
General sensation.roman: Kisi cheez ko chhune par bijli jaisa jhatka lagta hai.

General sensation.hi: चलते समय बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Chalte samay bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

General sensation.hi: पूरी तरह जागते हुए भी बिजली जैसे झटके लगते हैं।
General sensation.roman: Puri tarah jagte hue bhi bijli jaise jhatke lagte hain.

Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Kisi buri ya apriay baat ke bare mein sochne par nason mein kampkampi hoti hai.

Specific body area.roman: Taklif sharir mein tirche tarike se hoti hai.

Specific body area.roman: Taklif bai taraf upar aur dai taraf niche hoti hai.

Specific body area.roman: Taklif pehle bai taraf hoti hai, phir dai taraf chali jati hai.

Specific body area.hi: तकलीफ शरीर के दाईं तरफ होती है।

Specific body area.en: Your symptoms start on the right side of your body and then move to the left side.
Specific body area.hi: तकलीफ पहले दाईं तरफ होती है, फिर बाईं तरफ चली जाती है।
Specific body area.roman: taklif pehle daayin taraf hoti hai, phir baayin taraf chali jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.roman: abhi-abhi baithte hi taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.roman: abhi-abhi baithte hi taklif kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You feel you must sit up in bed with your knees pulled up toward you, resting your head and arms on your knees.

Linked to posture/position.roman: baithe rehne ke dauran taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your symptoms occur or change after waking from sleep.

Linked to time of day.roman: nind ke baad taklif par asar padta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Waking from sleep makes your symptoms worse.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के बाद तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।

Linked to time of day.roman: nind ke baad taklif kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, sleep, at beginning of, agg.
Linked to time of day.en: Your symptoms get worse right at the beginning of sleep, just after you fall asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद शुरू होते ही (शुरुआती नींद में) तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: nind shuru hote hi (shuruati nind me) taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Your symptoms get worse just before you fall asleep.

Linked to time of day.roman: sone se pehle taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.roman: nind ke dauran taklif badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.hi: अधनींद (ऊँघते) की अवस्था में तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Adhneend (oonghte) ki avastha mein takleef kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Sleeping for a long time makes your symptoms worse.
Linked to time of day.hi: ज़्यादा देर सोने से तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Zyada der sone se takleef badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A short sleep makes your symptoms better.
Linked to time of day.hi: थोड़ी देर की नींद से तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Thodi der ki neend se takleef kam ho jati hai.

General.en: Your symptoms are connected to what happens during sleep.
General.hi: नींद के दौरान तकलीफ पर असर पड़ता है।
General.roman: nind ke dauran taklif par asar padta hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Missing sleep or lack of sleep causes your symptoms.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: नींद न आने (जागते रहने) की वजह से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Neend na aane (jagte rehne) ki wajah se takleef hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, sluggishness of the body, morning
Linked to time of day.en: Your body feels sluggish and slow in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय शरीर में सुस्ती और भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay sharir mein susti aur bharipon mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, sluggishness of the body, morning, sitting, while
Linked to time of day.en: Your body feels sluggish and slow in the morning while you are sitting.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बैठे रहने पर शरीर में सुस्ती और भारीपन महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah baithte rehne par sharir mein susti aur bharipon mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: After a bowel movement, your symptoms get better.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के बाद तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke baad takleef kam ho jati hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: Having a bowel movement makes your symptoms worse.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के समय या उसके बाद तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke samay ya uske baad takleef badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Your symptoms get worse as a storm is approaching.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तूफान आने से पहले तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Toofan aane se pehle takleef badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Your symptoms get worse during a storm.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: तूफान के दौरान तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Toofan ke dauran takleef badh jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel an urge to stretch in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel an urge to stretch in the afternoon around 1 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर एक बजे शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ek baje sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel an urge to stretch in the afternoon around 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर चार बजे शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar char baje sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel an urge to stretch after sleeping in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर की नींद के बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ki nind ke baad sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body in the evening during chills.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को ठंड लगने के दौरान शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko thandi lagne ke dauran sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body in the late morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह दस बजे से पहले के समय में शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah das baje se pehle ke samay mein sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body at around 11 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह ग्यारह बजे शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah gyarah baje sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body at around 6 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह छह बजे शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah chhah baje sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body at around 7 in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह सात बजे शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah saat baje sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body while still lying in bed in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर में लेटे-लेटे शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar mein lete-lete sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, stretching, morning, stupefied, as if
Linked to time of day.en: When I stretch in the morning I feel dazed or mentally foggy, as if I am stupefied.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर सिर भारी और सुन्न-सा लगता है और शरीर खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne par sir bhari aur sunn-sa lagta hai aur sharir kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the need to stretch my body right when I wake up in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne par sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I stretch my body in my sleep during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को सोते समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko sote samay sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke samay sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body while lying in bed at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बिस्तर में शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bistar mein sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body when I wake up during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind khulne par sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body around midday/noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बारह बजे के आसपास शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar barah baje ke aaspass sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being in fresh open air makes the urge to stretch feel better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने से शरीर खींचने-तानने की इच्छा कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane se sharir khichne-tanne ki ichcha kam ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, stretching, anguish, with impending menses
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel an urge to stretch along with a sense of distress or anguish just before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने वाली हो तो घबराहट के साथ शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane wali ho to ghabrahat ke saath sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body around the time of my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke samay sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body before my menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ane se pehle sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body while I am having my menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: Anxiety makes you feel the urge to stretch your body.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: चिंता या बेचैनी होने पर शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Chinta ya bechainee hone par sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You feel an urge to stretch backwards.
Linked to posture/position.hi: शरीर को पीछे की तरफ खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sharir ko peeche ki taraf khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You feel an urge to stretch after breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: नाश्ते के बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Nashte ke baad sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: I feel the need to stretch my body after dinner.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात के खाने के बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ke khane ke baad sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: I feel the need to stretch my body after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: कुछ भी खाने के बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Kuch bhi khane ke baad sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: I feel the need to stretch my body after supper.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रात के खाने के बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Raat ke khane ke baad sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

General sensation.en: You feel an urge to stretch when you have chills.
General sensation.hi: ठंड लगने के साथ शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
General sensation.roman: Thand lagne ke saath sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

General sensation.en: You feel an urge to stretch just before chills start.
General sensation.hi: ठंड लगने से पहले शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
General sensation.roman: Thand lagne se pehle sharir ko khichne-tanne ki ichcha hoti hai.

General sensation.en: You feel an urge to stretch during chills.
General sensation.hi: ठंड लगने के दौरान शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
General sensation.roman: Thandi lagne ke dauran sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

General sensation.en: I have convulsive, spasm-like episodes of stretching that come in waves.
General sensation.hi: बार-बार झटके के साथ जोर से शरीर खिंचता है।
General sensation.roman: Bar-bar jhatke ke sath jor se sharir khichta hai.

General sensation.en: I am unable to stretch my body even though I want to.
General sensation.hi: शरीर को खींचना-तानना संभव नहीं हो पाता।
General sensation.roman: Sharir ko kheenchna-taanna sambhav nahi ho pata.

General sensation.path: Generalities, stretching, overstretched, sensation as if
General sensation.en: I have a sensation as if my body or limbs have been stretched too far or overstretched.
General sensation.hi: शरीर जरूरत से ज्यादा खिंच गया हो, ऐसा महसूस होता है।
General sensation.roman: Sharir zarurat se zyada khinch gaya ho, aisa mehsus hota hai.

General sensation.en: I feel an urge to stretch my body and I shudder or shiver while doing so.
General sensation.hi: कंपकंपी के दौरान शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
General sensation.roman: Kampkampi ke dauran sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

General sensation.path: Generalities, stretching, slept enough, as if he had not
General sensation.en: I feel the need to stretch as if I have not slept enough, even when I have.
General sensation.hi: पूरी नींद न आई हो, ऐसा लगता है और शरीर खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
General sensation.roman: Puri nind na ai ho, aisa lagta hai aur sharir kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

General sensation.en: My urge to stretch feels unsatisfying — stretching does not relieve the feeling.
General sensation.hi: शरीर खींचने-तानने के बाद भी संतुष्टि नहीं मिलती।
General sensation.roman: Sharir kheenchne-tanne ke baad bhi santusti nahi milti.

Temperature sensation.en: You feel an urge to stretch when you have an internal feeling of coldness inside your body.
Temperature sensation.hi: शरीर में अंदर से ठंडक महसूस होने के दौरान खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Sharir mein andar se thandi mehsus hone ke dauran kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: I feel an urge to stretch my body during cramping pains in my belly.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: पेट में मरोड़ उठने के दौरान शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Pet mein marod uthne ke dauran sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body while I have a fever.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बुखार के दौरान शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bukhar ke dauran sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body when I am indoors at home.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: घर के अंदर रहने पर शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Ghar ke andar rehne par sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body just before urinating.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: पेशाब आने से पहले शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Peshaab ane se pehle sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: I feel the need to stretch my body after coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खांसी के बाद शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khansi ke baad sharir ko kheenchne-taanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: I feel the urge to stretch my body while sitting and reading.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बैठकर पढ़ते समय शरीर को खींचने-तानने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baithakar padhte samay sharir ko kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Generalities, stretching, walking in open air amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: My urge to stretch gets better when I walk outside in the fresh air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खुली हवा में चलने से शरीर खींचने-तानने की इच्छा कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khuli hawa mein chalne se sharir kheenchne-tanne ki ichchha kam ho jati hai.

Type of pain.en: Stretching my body is painful.
Type of pain.hi: शरीर को खींचने-तानने में दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Sharir ko kheenchne-tanne mein dard hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: I feel unwell or my symptoms get worse when I exert myself in the sun.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: धूप में मेहनत करने से तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dhoop mein mehnat karne se takleef badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: I feel unwell or my symptoms are caused by being exposed to the sun.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: धूप में रहने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Dhoop mein rehne se takleef hoti hai.

General sensation.en: I have a sensation as if my glands are swollen, even if they do not appear swollen.
General sensation.hi: ग्रंथियाँ (गिल्टियाँ) सूजी हुई महसूस होती हैं।
General sensation.roman: Granthiya (giltiya) suji hui mehsus hoti hain.

General sensation.en: I have a feeling of tension on the outside surface of my body or skin.
General sensation.hi: शरीर की बाहरी त्वचा या मांसपेशियों में खिंचाव महसूस होता है।
General sensation.roman: Sharir ki bahari tvcha ya manspeashiyon mein khinchaav mehsus hota hai.

General sensation.en: I have a feeling of tension in my glands.
General sensation.hi: ग्रंथियों (गिल्टियों) में खिंचाव या तनाव महसूस होता है।
General sensation.roman: Granthiyon (giltyon) mein khinchaav ya tanav mehsus hota hai.

General sensation.en: I have a feeling of tension deep inside my body.
General sensation.hi: शरीर के अंदर से खिंचाव या तनाव महसूस होता है।

Comes with other symptoms.roman: Kamzori ke sath-sath kampkampi bhi hoti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You feel weak or lacking in energy after getting angry.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: गुस्से के बाद कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Gusse ke baad kamzori mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You feel weak after getting excited or emotionally worked up.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: उत्तेजना (興奮/जोश) के बाद कमज़ोरी आती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Uttejna ke baad kamzori aati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You feel weak after being frightened.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: डर/भय लगने के बाद कमज़ोरी आती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Dar bhay lagne ke baad kamzori aati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on after being humiliated or deeply upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: किसी बात से बहुत दुख या अपमान हो तो उसके बाद कमज़ोरी आ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: kisi baat se bahut dukh ya apmaan ho to uske baad kamzori aa jati hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.en: You feel weak after getting angry or upset.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: किसी बात से मन खराब होने या गुस्सा आने के बाद कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Kisi baat se man kharab hone ya gussa aane ke baad kamzori hoti hai.

General sensation.path: Generalities, weakness, death, as of approaching
General sensation.en: You feel so weak that you feel as if you are close to death.
General sensation.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे मौत करीब आ रही हो, बहुत ज़्यादा कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise maut karib aa rahi ho, bahut zyada kamzori mehsus hoti hai.

General sensation.en: You feel a kind of weak, pleasantly drained feeling, as if you have just been exhilarated.
General sensation.hi: ऐसा लगता है जैसे कुछ अच्छा हुआ हो और उसके बाद कमज़ोरी आती है।
General sensation.roman: Aisa lagta hai jaise kuch acha hua ho aur uske baad kamzori aati hai.

General sensation.en: A general feeling of weakness that feels like paralysis.
General sensation.hi: शरीर में लकवे जैसी कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
General sensation.roman: Sharir mein lakwe jaisi kamzori mehsoos hoti hai.

General sensation.path: Generalities, weakness, paralytic, painful parts, in
General sensation.en: A general feeling of paralytic weakness felt in the painful parts of the body.
General sensation.hi: जहाँ दर्द है उस हिस्से में लकवे जैसी कमज़ोरी लगती है।
General sensation.roman: Jahan dard hai us hisse mein lakwe jaisi kamzori lagti hai.

General sensation.en: A general feeling of weakness that feels like extreme sleepiness.
General sensation.hi: ऐसी कमज़ोरी जैसे बहुत नींद आ रही हो।
General sensation.roman: Aisi kamzori jaise bahut neend aa rahi ho.

General sensation.path: Generalities, weakness, sleepiness, as from, afternoon, walking amel.
General sensation.en: A general feeling of weakness that feels like extreme sleepiness, which gets better when walking in the afternoon.
General sensation.hi: दोपहर में चलने से ऐसी कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है जो बहुत नींद आने जैसी लगती है।
General sensation.roman: Dopahar mein chalne se aisi kamzori kam ho jati hai jo bahut neend aane jaisi lagti hai.

General sensation.path: Generalities, weakness, sudden, vanish, as if senses would
General sensation.en: A sudden general feeling of weakness where your senses feel as if they are about to fade away.
General sensation.hi: अचानक ऐसी कमज़ोरी आती है जैसे होश उड़ जाएंगे।
General sensation.roman: Achanak aisi kamzori aati hai jaise hosh ud jayenge.

Linked to bowel movement.en: You feel weak as a result of having diarrhoea.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: दस्त (पतले मल) लगने से कमज़ोरी आती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Dast (patle mal) lagne se kamzori ati hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: A general feeling of weakness related to having a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के समय कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke samay kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on after having a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के बाद कमज़ोरी आ जाती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke baad kamzori aa jati hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on before having a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच से पहले कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch se pehle kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on during a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच करते वक्त कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch karte waqt kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to bowel movement.en: You feel weak and shaky after a bowel movement.
Linked to bowel movement.hi: शौच के बाद कंपकंपी के साथ कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to bowel movement.roman: Shauch ke baad kampkampi ke saath kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: You feel weak after grief or emotional loss.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: दुख या शोक के बाद कमज़ोरी आती है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Dukh ya shok ke baad kamzori aati hai.

Linked to mood/emotion.en: An unhappy or unrequited love situation makes you feel weak.
Linked to mood/emotion.hi: प्रेम में निराशा (दिल टूटने) से कमज़ोरी आती है।
Linked to mood/emotion.roman: Prem mein nirasha (dil tutne) se kamzori aati hai.

Temperature sensation.en: You feel weak when you feel hot.
Temperature sensation.hi: गर्मी के साथ कमज़ोरी होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Garmi ke saath kamzori hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.en: Heat makes you feel weak.
Temperature sensation.hi: गर्मी की वजह से कमज़ोरी होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Garmi ki wajah se kamzori hoti hai.

Temperature sensation.path: Generalities, weakness, heat, thrills of heat, from
Temperature sensation.en: Waves or rushes of heat make you feel weak.
Temperature sensation.hi: शरीर में गर्मी की लहरें उठने से कमज़ोरी होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Sharir mein garmi ki lahren uthne se kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, leaning towards left during menses amel.
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Leaning toward the left side during your menstrual period makes your weakness better.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान बाईं तरफ झुकने से कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran bayin taraf jhukne se kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak around the time of your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak after your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के बाद बहुत कमज़ोरी आ जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke baad bahut kamzori aa jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, menses, after, disproportionate to loss of blood
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel unusually weak after your period, more than would be expected from the amount of blood you lost.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के बाद जितना खून गया उससे कहीं ज़्यादा कमज़ोरी हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke baad jitna khun gaya usse kahin zyada kamzori ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your weakness gets better during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने पर कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane par kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, menses, appearance of, amel.
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your weakness gets better when your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी शुरू होते ही कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari shuru hote hi kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak at the very start of your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी शुरू होने की शुरुआत में बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari shuru hone ki shuruaat mein bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak before your menstrual period begins.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, menses, breathe, can scarcely, must lie down
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During your menstrual period you feel so weak you can barely breathe and have to lie down.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान इतनी कमज़ोरी होती है कि साँस लेना मुश्किल हो जाता है और लेटना पड़ता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran itni kamzori hoti hai ki sans lena mushkil ho jata hai aur letna padta hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, menses, desire to lie down, with
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During your menstrual period you feel so weak that you need to lie down.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान इतनी कमज़ोरी लगती है कि लेटने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran itni kamzori lagti hai ki letne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Your weakness gets worse during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान कमज़ोरी और बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran kamzori aur badh jati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak at the end of your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के आखिर में बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke akhir mein bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, menses, going upstairs, when
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During your menstrual period you feel too weak to climb stairs.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ने पर बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran sidiyan chadne par bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak when your menstrual period is painful.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी दर्दनाक हो तो कमज़ोरी भी बहुत आती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari dardnak ho to kamzori bhi bahut ati hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During your menstrual period you feel weak after a bowel movement.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान शौच के बाद बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran shauch ke baad bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.path: Generalities, weakness, menses, talk, can scarcely
Linked to menstrual cycle.en: During your menstrual period you feel so weak you can barely speak.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान इतनी कमज़ोरी होती है कि ठीक से बात भी नहीं हो पाती।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran itni kamzori hoti hai ki theek se baat bhi nahi ho pati.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weak when walking during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान चलने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran chalne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You feel weak when lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down makes your weakness worse.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने से कमज़ोरी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne se kamzori badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Lying down makes your weakness better.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने से कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne se kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, lying, on back amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: Lying on your back makes your weakness better.
Linked to posture/position.hi: पीठ के बल लेटने से कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Peeth ke bal letne se kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, lying, with legs drawn up
Linked to posture/position.en: You feel weak when lying down with your legs drawn up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: टाँगें मोड़कर लेटने पर कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Tangein modkar letne par kamzori mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness in the morning while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सुबह लेटे रहने पर कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: subah lete rahne par kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, motion, when moved from horizontal position
Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on when being moved from a lying-flat position.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सीधे लेटे हुए से उठकर बैठने पर बहुत कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: sidhe lete hue se uthkar baithe par bahut kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, paralytic, sliding down in bed
Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of paralytic weakness causing you to slide down in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लकवे जैसी कमज़ोरी की वजह से बिस्तर में नीचे की तरफ खिसकता जाता हूँ।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lakwe jaisi kamzori ki wajah se bistar mein neeche ki taraf khiskta jata hoon.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, resting head on something and closing eyes amel.
Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that gets better when resting your head on something and closing your eyes.
Linked to posture/position.hi: सिर को किसी चीज़ पर टिका कर आँखें बंद करने से कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Sir ko kisi cheez par tika kar aankhen band karne se kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness when getting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on after getting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठने के बाद कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthne ke baad kamzori mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on when getting up.
Linked to posture/position.hi: उठते वक्त कमज़ोरी लगती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Uthte waqt kamzori lagti hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, rising, seat, from a
Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that comes on when getting up from a seated position.
Linked to posture/position.hi: कुर्सी या सीट से उठने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Kursi ya seat se uthne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithey rehne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that gets worse while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठने से कमज़ोरी बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithne se kamzori badh jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness that gets better while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठने से कमज़ोरी कम हो जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithne se kamzori kam ho jati hai.

Linked to posture/position.path: Generalities, weakness, sitting, walk, after a
Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness while sitting after having gone for a walk.
Linked to posture/position.hi: थोड़ा चलने के बाद बैठने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Thoda chalne ke baad baithne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A general feeling of weakness while standing.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खड़े रहने पर कमज़ोरी होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Khde rehne par kamzori hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: A sudden general feeling of weakness while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे-बैठे अचानक कमज़ोरी आ जाती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithe-baithe achanak kamzori aa jati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: A general feeling of weakness originating from the stomach area.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: पेट में कमज़ोरी महसूस होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Pet mein kamzori mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel weary and tired in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद शरीर में थकान और सुस्ती रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad sharir mein thakan aur susti rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel weary and tired in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Generalities, weariness, evening, in open air
Linked to time of day.en: You feel weary in the evening when you are in the open air.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को बाहर खुली हवा में रहने पर थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ko bahar khuli hava mein rehne par thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel weary and tired in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne par thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: You feel weary at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Talking or having a conversation makes you feel weary.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: किसी से बात करने के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kisi se baat karne ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Mental effort or thinking hard makes you feel weary.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: दिमागी काम या मानसिक मेहनत करने से थकान और सुस्ती आ जाती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dimaagi kaam ya mansik mehnat karne se thakan aur susti aa jati hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Playing the piano makes you feel weary.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पियानो बजाने के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Piano bajane ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Reading makes you feel weary.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: पढ़ने के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Padhne ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel weary after talking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बात करने के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Baat karne ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel weary after walking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: चलने के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Chalne ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You feel weary in connection with eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाने से संबंधित थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khane se sambandh thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You feel weary after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: You feel weary while you are eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weary in connection with your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान थकान और सुस्ती रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran thakan aur susti rehti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weary after your menstrual period has finished.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के बाद थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke baad thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weary before your menstrual period starts.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: You feel weary during your menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दिनों में थकान और सुस्ती रहती है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dinon mein thakan aur susti rehti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You feel weary while sitting.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बैठे रहने पर थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Baithe rehne par thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: You feel weary when standing.
Linked to posture/position.hi: खड़े रहने पर थकान और सुस्ती महसूस होती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Khade rehne par thakan aur susti mehsus hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting wet (being caught in rain or soaked) makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: भीगने या गीले होने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bhigne ya gile hone se taklif hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting your feet wet makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पैर भीग जाने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Pair bhig jane se taklif hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting your head wet makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: सिर भीग जाने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Sir bheeg jane se takleef hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Getting wet while sweating makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: पसीना आते समय भीगने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Pasina aate samay bhigne se takleef hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Wet weather makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गीले मौसम में तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Gile mausam mein takleef badh jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Wet weather makes your symptoms better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गीले मौसम में तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Gile mausam mein takleef kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold wind makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा लगने से तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa lagne se takleef hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Generalities, wind, cold, riding in, amel.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Riding in cold wind makes your symptoms better.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी हवा में सवारी करने से तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi hawa mein sawari karne se takleef kam ho jati hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Warm southerly wind makes your symptoms worse.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: गर्म दक्षिणी हवा चलने पर तकलीफ होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Garm dakshin hawa chalne par takleef hoti hai.

General sensation.en: You have a general sensation as though wind is affecting your body.
General sensation.hi: शरीर में हवा चलने जैसा अहसास होता है।
General sensation.roman: Sharir mein hawa chalne jaisa ehsaas hota hai.

Sensation type.en: You have a sensation of wind blowing on you or through you.
Sensation type.hi: शरीर में हवा बहने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation type.roman: Sharir mein hawa bahne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation type.path: Generalities, wind, sensation, of, blowing on covered parts
Sensation type.en: You have a sensation of wind blowing on a part of your body that is covered up.
Sensation type.hi: ढके हुए शरीर के हिस्सों पर ठंडी हवा फूंकने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation type.roman: Dhake hue sharir ke hisson par thandi hawa phunkne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation type.en: You have a sensation of cold wind blowing on you.
Sensation type.hi: शरीर में ठंडी हवा चलने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation type.roman: Sharir mein thandi hawa chalne jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Drinking wine makes your symptoms worse.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: शराब पीने से तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Sharab pine se takleef badh jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Drinking wine makes your symptoms better.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: शराब पीने से तकलीफ कम हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Sharab pine se takleef kam ho jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Drinking sour wine makes your symptoms worse.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खट्टी शराब पीने से तकलीफ बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khatti sharab pine se takleef badh jati hai.
